name: Build the chord
description: Play a chord on a two-octave piano. A new root and quality every review; any voicing or inversion counts, graded by pitch classes.

fields.name: prompt
fields.default: Build this chord on the keyboard.
fields.description: Shown above the chord name (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: qualities
fields.description: Chord qualities to draw from: maj, min, dim, aug, maj7, 7, m7, m7b5, dim7, sus4.
